docs.text: Published workforce, survey and staffing results for every federal organization, side by side, to find patterns no single source shows. | Les résultats publiés sur l’effectif, les sondages et la dotation de chaque organisation fédérale, côte à côte, pour repérer des tendances qu’aucune source ne montre seule. Equity across the public service Where the data agree Government sources measure equity in different ways: who works where, what employees say in two separate surveys, and who gets hired. This page puts them side by side for every federal organization to find patterns that no single source shows. A pattern tells you where to look first. It does not prove discrimination, and it does not tell you what happened to any one person. Sources: Treasury Board workforce data to March 31, 2025; Public Service Employee Survey, 2019 to 2024; Staffing and Non-Partisanship Survey, 2025; Public Service Commission staffing data. The comparisons are calculated by this site from the published figures. They are not Government of Canada statistics. New here? Read the five-minute guide. docs.text: Accessibility approach, known limitations and feedback for the independent Duty to Accommodate evidence site. Accessibility and plain language This independent research website aims to be usable by everyone, including people who use assistive technology, a keyboard, a phone or a screen magnifier. Current status: improvements made, full conformance not yet established.We have reviewed the code and strengthened important features. We have not yet completed end-to-end testing with assistive technologies and users with disabilities. We therefore do not claim full WCAG conformance. Our design approach We use WCAG 2.2 Level AA as our technical design goal. We also follow the Canada.ca Content Style Guide and plain-language guidance when writing and organizing the site. This independent project does not claim to be a Government of Canada website. Use the language buttons to switch between English and French summaries. Use the skip link to move to the main content. Search and filter tables using labeled controls and your keyboard. Read numerical findings as text without relying on charts or colour. Use the source link in each record to check the original evidence. Known limitations Some original research documents are only available in English, and some external PDFs may not be fully accessible. We provide French summaries of our catalogue records, not translations of every original document. Downloaded CSV files contain technical column names in English.
